Correct install forms:

```bash
claude plugins marketplace add mikeparcewski/wicked-garden
claude plugins install wicked-garden
npm i -g wicked-vault && wicked-vault-install
npm install -g wicked-crew && wicked-crew serve
npx wicked-installer
cargo install wicked-estate wicked-estate-mcp  # puts wicked-estate + wicked-estate-mcp on PATH
```
